records.jp: あ、千紘
records.en_original: Ah, Chihiro.
records.en_auxiliary: Ah, Chihiro.
records.en: Ah, Chihiro.

records.jp: 日菜子……さん……
records.en_original: Hinako...
records.en_auxiliary: Hinako?
records.en: Hinako...

records.jp: 最近、調子いい？
records.en_original: Doing well lately?
records.en_auxiliary: Doing well lately?
records.en: Doing well lately?

records.jp: そっか。<CR>学校の花壇も以前と比べてきれいになったもんね
records.en_original: Good. The flowerbeds around school are a lot prettier than they were before.
records.en_auxiliary: The flowerbeds around school are a lot prettier than they were before.
records.en: Good. The flowerbeds around school are a lot prettier than they were before.

records.jp: これも千紘の頑張りのおかげだね……
records.en_original: And it's all because of you.
records.en_auxiliary: And it's all because of you.
records.en: And it's all because of you.

records.jp: えへへ……ありがとう……
records.en_original: Ehehe... Thank you...
records.en_auxiliary: Ehehe... Thank you.
records.en: Ehehe... Thank you...

records.jp: それで、花壇見た人から何か反応あった？
records.en_original: So, did you hear any reactions from people who saw the flowerbeds?
records.en_auxiliary: So, did you hear any reactions from people who saw the flowerbeds?
records.en: So, did you hear any reactions from people who saw the flowerbeds?

records.jp: この前……作業……してたら……<CR>先生に……ありがとうって……
records.en_original: The other day...while I was working...a teacher...said thank you...
records.en_auxiliary: The other day while I was working... a teacher said thank you.
records.en: The other day...while I was working...a teacher...said thank you...

records.jp: へぇ！　よかったね！
records.en_original: Wow! That's great!
records.en_auxiliary: Wow! That's great!
records.en: Wow! That's great!

records.jp: あと……最近……クラスの……子たち……<CR>花壇が……きれいに……なったって……話してる……
records.en_original: Also...lately....people in class...talk about how pretty...the flower beds are...
records.en_auxiliary: Also, lately... people in class talk about how pretty... the flower beds are.
records.en: Also...lately....people in class...talk about how pretty...the flower beds are...

records.jp: 噂にもなってるんだ……<CR>すごいね！
records.en_original: You've really got people talking... That's awesome!
records.en_auxiliary: You've really got people talking! That's awesome!
records.en: You've really got people talking... That's awesome!

records.jp: これで、少しは自信ついたんじゃない？
records.en_original: Do you feel like you've gained a little confidence?
records.en_auxiliary: Do you feel like you've gained a little confidence?
records.en: Do you feel like you've gained a little confidence?

records.jp: ありがとう……日菜子……さんの……おかげ……
records.en_original: Thank you... You...inspired me...Hinako...
records.en_auxiliary: Thank you. You inspired me... Hinako.
records.en: Thank you... You...inspired me...Hinako...

records.jp: 大好きな……お花で……みんなに……<CR>喜んで……もらえて……
records.en_original: I love...flowers... And it's making...everyone happy...
records.en_auxiliary: I love flowers. And it's making everyone happy.
records.en: I love...flowers... And it's making...everyone happy...

records.jp: 嬉し……かった
records.en_original: I'm...happy.
records.en_auxiliary: I'm... happy.
records.en: I'm...happy.

records.jp: （千紘、ホントにお花が好きなんだ……）
records.en_original: (Chihiro must really like flowers...)
records.en_auxiliary: (Chihiro must really like flowers.)
records.en: (Chihiro must really like flowers...)

records.jp: だから……その……何か……お礼を……
records.en_original: So...I want to...reward you...
records.en_auxiliary: So I want to... reward you.
records.en: So...I want to...reward you...

records.jp: お礼？<CR>いいよー。お礼なんて
records.en_original: Reward me? Oh, don't worry about that.
records.en_auxiliary: Reward me? Oh, don't worry about that.
records.en: Reward me? Oh, don't worry about that.

records.jp: 何でも……いいから……
records.en_original: It can be...anything...
records.en_auxiliary: It can be... anything.
records.en: It can be...anything...

records.jp: うーん……急にお礼って言われても……
records.en_original: Hmm... Let me think...
records.en_auxiliary: Hmm. Let me think.
records.en: Hmm... Let me think...

records.jp: （あっ！　そうだ！）
records.en_original: (Oh! I know!)
records.en_auxiliary: (Oh! I know!)
records.en: (Oh! I know!)

records.jp: それじゃあさ、今からファミレスで――
records.en_original: Alright, then let's go to the diner now and...
records.en_auxiliary: All right, then let's go to the diner now and...
records.en: Alright, then let's go to the diner now and...

records.jp: 千紘のこともっと教えてよ
records.en_original: ...you can me more about yourself, Chihiro.
records.en_auxiliary: ...You can tell me more about yourself, Chihiro.
records.en: ...you can me more about yourself, Chihiro.

records.jp: 私、千紘ともっと仲良くなりたいし、<CR>私のことも千紘にもっと知ってもらいたい
records.en_original: I want to get to know you better, and I want you to know me better, too.
records.en_auxiliary: I want to get to know you better, and I want you to know me better, too.
records.en: I want to get to know you better, and I want you to know me better, too.

records.jp: 日菜子……さんが……いいなら……
records.en_original: If you...don't mind... Sure...
records.en_auxiliary: If you don't mind. Sure.
records.en: If you...don't mind... Sure...

records.jp: それじゃ、決まり！<CR>ファミレスにでも行ってゆっくり話そう
records.en_original: Then it's decided! Let's go to the diner and have a nice chat.
records.en_auxiliary: Then it's decided! Let's go to the diner and have a nice chat.
records.en: Then it's decided! Let's go to the diner and have a nice chat.

records.jp: へぇ……。ぬいぐるみってそうやって作るんだ。<CR>結構難しそうだね
records.en_original: Huh... So that's how you make stuffed toys. It sounds pretty difficult.
records.en_auxiliary: Huh... So that's how you make stuffed toys. It sounds pretty difficult.
records.en: Huh... So that's how you make stuffed toys. It sounds pretty difficult.

records.jp: ううん……。慣れれば……簡単……
records.en_original: Not really... It's easy...when you get used to it...
records.en_auxiliary: Not really. It's easy... when you get used to it.
records.en: Not really... It's easy...when you get used to it...

records.jp: ところで、何で千紘はお花とかぬいぐるみが好きになったの？
records.en_original: By the way, why do you like flowers and plushies so much?
records.en_auxiliary: By the way, why do you like flowers and plushies so much?
records.en: By the way, why do you like flowers and plushies so much?

records.jp: 小さい……頃に……近所の……おばあさんが……いて……
records.en_original: When I...was little...there was an...old lady...in my neighborhood...
records.en_auxiliary: When I was little... there was an old lady in my neighborhood.
records.en: When I...was little...there was an...old lady...in my neighborhood...

records.jp: うん
records.en_original: Yeah?
records.en_auxiliary: Yeah?
records.en: Yeah?

records.jp: わたしが……育てた……チューリップ。誕生日に……<CR>プレゼント……したら……とても……喜んで……くれたの
records.en_original: I was...growing tulips... I gave her some...on her birthday...and she was so happy...
records.en_auxiliary: I was growing tulips. I gave her some... on her birthday. And she was so happy.
records.en: I was...growing tulips... I gave her some...on her birthday...and she was so happy...

records.jp: それがうれしかったんだ……
records.en_original: That would make me happy, too.
records.en_auxiliary: That would make me happy, too.
records.en: That would make me happy, too.

records.jp: なるほどねー。<CR>それじゃあ、ぬいぐるみは？
records.en_original: I see. So what about the stuffed toys?
records.en_auxiliary: I see. So what about the stuffed toys?
records.en: I see. So what about the stuffed toys?

records.jp: 小学生の……時……初めて……作ったの
records.en_original: I made one...for the first time...in elementary school...
records.en_auxiliary: I made one for the first time... in elementary school.
records.en: I made one...for the first time...in elementary school...

records.jp: その……ぬいぐるみを……見て……大好きな……先生が……<CR>ほめてくれて……
records.en_original: After seeing it...the teacher I liked...praised me...
records.en_auxiliary: After seeing it... the teacher I liked said nice things.
records.en: After seeing it...the teacher I liked...praised me...

records.jp: それが……嬉しくて……
records.en_original: That made me...happy...
records.en_auxiliary: That made me... really happy.
records.en: That made me...happy...

records.jp: そうなんだ。<CR>何か千紘らしくていいね
records.en_original: I see. That sounds like you, Chihiro.
records.en_auxiliary: I see. That sounds like you, Chihiro.
records.en: I see. That sounds like you, Chihiro.

records.jp: あり……がとう
records.en_original: Thank...you.
records.en_auxiliary: Thank... you.
records.en: Thank...you.

records.jp: 時間も結構経ったし、そろそろ行こっか
records.en_original: It's gotten pretty late, we should go soon.
records.en_auxiliary: It's gotten pretty late, we should go soon.
records.en: It's gotten pretty late, we should go soon.

records.jp: 日菜子さん……今日まで……いろいろ……ありがとう。<CR>おかげで……少し……自信が……出た
records.en_original: Hinako... Thank you...for everything...you've done for me... You've given me...a little confidence...
records.en_auxiliary: Hinako, thank you... for everything you've done for me. You've given me... a little confidence.
records.en: Hinako-san... Thank you...for everything...you've done for me... You've given me...a little confidence...

records.jp: ううん。私の方こそお花の世話とか一緒にできて楽しかったし、<CR>千紘と仲良くなれてよかったよ……
records.en_original: No problem. It was fun taking care of the flowers with you, and I'm glad we're becoming better friends.
records.en_auxiliary: No problem. It was fun taking care of the flowers with you, and I'm glad we're becoming better friends.
records.en: No problem. It was fun taking care of the flowers with you, and I'm glad we're becoming better friends.

records.jp: これからも……よろしく
records.en_original: Let's...keep it up.
records.en_auxiliary: I like that... too.
records.en: Let's...keep it up.

records.jp: こちらこそよろしくね
records.en_original: I'm sure we will.
records.en_auxiliary: I'm glad.
records.en: I'm sure we will.

records.jp: それじゃ、帰ろ！
records.en_original: Anyway, let's get going!
records.en_auxiliary: Anyway, let's get going!
records.en: Anyway, let's get going!

records.jp: 千紘の昔の話聞かせてよ
records.en_original: ...you can tell me about your past.
records.en_auxiliary: ...You can tell me about your past.
records.en: ...you can tell me about your past.

records.jp: 私、千紘がどんな子だったか興味あるんだ！
records.en_original: I want to know what kind of kid you were!
records.en_auxiliary: I want to know what kind of kid you were!
records.en: I want to know what kind of kid you were!

records.jp: ね！　いいでしょ？
records.en_original: So? What do you say?
records.en_auxiliary: So? What do you say?
records.en: So? What do you say?

records.jp: それじゃあ、早速行こう
records.en_original: Alright then, let's go!
records.en_auxiliary: All right then, let's go!
records.en: Alright then, let's go!

records.jp: へぇ……千紘って小さいころからお花育ててたんだ
records.en_original: Huh... So you've been growing flowers since you were a kid.
records.en_auxiliary: Huh... So you've been growing flowers since you were a kid.
records.en: Huh... So you've been growing flowers since you were a kid.

records.jp: それで、近所のおばあさんにチューリップをプレゼントしたら<CR>喜ばれたんだ
records.en_original: And the old lady in your neighborhood was really happy when you gave some to her.
records.en_auxiliary: And the old lady in your neighborhood was really happy when you gave some to her.
records.en: And the old lady in your neighborhood was really happy when you gave some to her.

records.jp: わたし……それが……嬉しくて……
records.en_original: That... Made me happy, too...
records.en_auxiliary: That... made me happy, too.
records.en: That... Made me happy, too...

records.jp: そっか……何か千紘らしいね……
records.en_original: I see... That sounds just like you, Chihiro...
records.en_auxiliary: I see. That sounds just like you, Chihiro.
records.en: I see... That sounds just like you, Chihiro...

records.jp: へへへ……
records.en_original: Hehehe...
records.en_auxiliary: Hehehe...
records.en: Hehehe...

records.jp: あと、もう一つ疑問だったんだけど……<CR>何でぬいぐるみをよく作るようになったの？
records.en_original: I had another question, too...why did you start making stuffed toys?
records.en_auxiliary: I had another question, too. Why did you start making stuffed toys?
records.en: I had another question, too...why did you start making stuffed toys?

records.jp: わたしが……初めて……作った……ぬいぐるみを……<CR>小学校の……先生が……褒めて……くれて
records.en_original: The first...stuffed toy I made...got me complimented...by my...elementary school teacher...
records.en_auxiliary: The first stuffed toy I made... was complimented by my... elementary school teacher.
records.en: The first...stuffed toy I made...got me complimented...by my...elementary school teacher...

records.jp: それが……嬉しくて……
records.en_original: That...made me happy...
records.en_auxiliary: That... made me really happy.
records.en: That...made me happy...

records.jp: よく作るようになったんだ……
records.en_original: Well, you're great at making them now.
records.en_auxiliary: Well, you're great at making them now.
records.en: Well, you're great at making them now.

records.jp: （千紘ってやっぱりかわいい……）
records.en_original: (Chihiro is really cute...)
records.en_auxiliary: (Chihiro is really cute.)
records.en: (Chihiro is really cute...)

records.jp: もうそろそろ、いい時間だし帰ろっか？
records.en_original: It's getting kind of late, should we get going soon?
records.en_auxiliary: It's getting kind of late, should we get going soon?
records.en: It's getting kind of late, should we get going soon?

records.jp: 日菜子……さん。<CR>今日は……誘って……くれて……あり……がとう
records.en_original: Hinako... Thank you...for inviting me...today...
records.en_auxiliary: Hinako, thank you... for inviting me today.
records.en: Hinako... Thank you...for inviting me...today...

records.jp: とっても……楽し……かった
records.en_original: It was...really fun...
records.en_auxiliary: It was... really fun.
records.en: It was...really fun...

records.jp: 私もだよ……。昔の千紘のこといろいろ知れて楽しかった。<CR>千紘！　ありがとう！
records.en_original: Same here. It was fun hearing about your past. Thanks, Chihiro!
records.en_auxiliary: Same here. It was fun hearing about your past. Thanks, Chihiro!
records.en: Same here. It was fun hearing about your past. Thanks, Chihiro!

records.jp: へへへ……
records.en_original: Hehehe...
records.en_auxiliary: Hehehe...
records.en: Hehehe...

records.jp: それじゃ、行こっ！
records.en_original: Anyway, let's get going!
records.en_auxiliary: Anyway, let's get going!
records.en: Anyway, let's get going!
